evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Stating a mandatory process as established fact draws on legitimate power — the authority of an agreed process — without framing it as persuasion or pressure.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Supplying a factual correction about what the checklist superseded is informational influence — controlling the facts of the record.
